title: Subnet News — August 11, 2026
summary: Engy's temporary enterprise-model whitelist triggered the day's largest subnet dispute, with the team promising to preserve permissionless access for other model tiers. Ditto merged its v9 benchmark stack but delayed activation pending validator upgrades, Nepher Robotics prepared a humanoid tournament and KYM framework, ORO reviewed exploitable ranking behavior, and Sundae Bar opened a review of similarity gates. On-chain archive data confirmed strong rotation into ORO and smaller inflows into Quasar and Allways among the markets recovered at the cutoff, while iota, Targon, and TrajectoryRL showed material TAO reserve outflows. Bittensor's v444 release work also landed multiple runtime and EVM fixes. No corroborated future alpha unlock was found.

highlights.headline: SN53 Engy whitelist policy draws permissionless-mining backlash
highlights.summary: Engy required new enterprise-model miners to apply through a whitelist, prompting complaints about mid-epoch losses and centralization. The team said the control was temporary for enterprise fraud prevention and promised that non-enterprise model tiers would remain permissionless from the next epoch.

highlights.headline: SN118 Ditto merges v9 stack but delays activation
highlights.summary: Ditto merged an 11-PR benchmark stack, fixed a tool-case scoring defect, and completed a long-memory test. Activation was postponed until at least three validators upgraded; a temporary emission burn was applied before the new benchmark goes live.

highlights.headline: SN49 Nepher prepares humanoid tournament and KYM framework
highlights.summary: Nepher Robotics said its Humanoid Run Jump tournament was targeted within 48 hours, subject to final scoring adjustments, and discussed a Know Your Miners framework intended to improve accountability without closing participation.

highlights.headline: SN15 ORO identifies ranking vulnerabilities
highlights.summary: ORO's team said cache handling, dead code, validator variance, and consecutive race appearances could distort its three-race average. A per-race evaluation model and standardized validator scoring were under discussion, not yet final.

highlights.headline: Bittensor v444 release work lands runtime and EVM fixes
highlights.summary: The official monorepo merged the v444 release branch after fixes covering precompile conversions, commitment cleanup on UID trimming, voting-power cleanup on subnet dissolution, multisig dispatch ordering, and release CI. This is protocol engineering activity; deployment status should be read from chain state rather than inferred from the merge alone.

highlights.headline: Archived tape shows rotation into ORO while major pools lose TAO
highlights.summary: At the August 11 10:00 AM ET cutoff, recovered hourly archive samples showed ORO up about 12.8% with roughly 758 TAO added to its pool; Quasar added about 106 TAO and Allways about 25 TAO. iota lost roughly 538 TAO from its pool, Targon about 510 TAO, and TrajectoryRL about 455 TAO. The historical endpoint returned only a partial network set during backfill, so these are verified examples, not a claimed full-network ranking.

updates.headline: Historical pool reserve declined at the report cutoff
updates.summary: Recovered hourly chain samples showed approximately 510 TAO less in Targon's pool across the report window and a price decline of about 0.8%. This describes pool movement only and does not identify the traders or predict future performance.

updates.headline: Historical tape records material TAO reserve outflow
updates.summary: Recovered hourly samples showed roughly 538 TAO leaving iota's pool across the window, with price down about 1.9%. No project announcement was found that explained or attributed the flow.

updates.headline: Pool reserve contracts during the report window
updates.summary: Recovered hourly samples showed approximately 455 TAO leaving the TrajectoryRL pool and its alpha price declining about 4.6% by the cutoff. No matching team announcement was verified.

updates.headline: Team reviews ranking exploits as ORO leads recovered tape
updates.summary: The team identified ways cache handling, dead code, validator variance, and race sequencing could distort rankings and discussed per-race scoring. Separately, recovered chain samples showed ORO up about 12.8% with roughly 758 TAO added to its pool across the report window.

updates.headline: Repository work extends the anti-cheating hotfix
updates.summary: Score's public repository recorded fixes for winner-shard and manifest reads, response cleanup, and audit export during the coverage window, extending the operational patch work reported a day earlier.

updates.headline: Humanoid tournament and KYM initiative prepared
updates.summary: The team targeted a Humanoid Run Jump tournament within 48 hours, pending scoring adjustments, and described a Know Your Miners framework for miner and validator accountability. The tournament was not yet live at the cutoff.

updates.headline: Enterprise whitelist triggers miner backlash
updates.summary: Engy's temporary Google Forms whitelist for new enterprise-model miners produced a broad dispute about centralization and mid-epoch losses. The team said the restriction was for enterprise quality and fraud controls and promised permissionless participation for other tiers next epoch.

updates.headline: Benchmark v9 activation delayed after release stack merge
updates.summary: The team merged 11 pull requests, fixed a tool-case scoring issue, and completed a long-memory test, but delayed activation until at least three validators adopted the new image. A temporary emission burn was applied before activation.

updates.headline: Reason v3 rollout tooling advances in public repository
updates.summary: Affine's public repository recorded a dense series of rollout, scheduler, trace-store, evaluation, and Reason v3 operations commits before the cutoff. The activity is verified code shipping; production effects were not independently measured in this window.

updates.headline: Similarity thresholds enter challenge-level review
updates.summary: After miner feedback that a 93% similarity gate could block meaningful work on small skills, the team committed to reviewing thresholds by challenge. No immediate parameter change was announced.

ecosystem.headline: Protocol repository merges v444 release branch
ecosystem.summary: The official monorepo merged release-444 and associated runtime, EVM, state-cleanup, multisig, and release-pipeline corrections. A repository merge confirms code integration, not automatic mainnet activation.

ecosystem.headline: No verified registration, deregistration, alpha halving, or scheduled unlock surfaced
ecosystem.summary: The public source sweep did not identify a corroborated slot registration or deregistration, subnet alpha halving, or future unlock announcement inside the window. Conviction decay remains continuous and was not converted into a one-day token-unlock claim.
